name: Quiet serif
rationale: A compact serif candle stays close to the original i; a single-color flame replaces its dot.

name: Birthday candle
rationale: A slightly taller wax stem and broad amber flame make the candle easier to see.

name: Fine wick
rationale: A narrower stem, tiny wick and leaning amber flame give the mark a handwritten warmth.

name: Soft wax
rationale: A broader, taller stem with a shallow wax dip supports a compact white flame and visible wick.
